title: Why Do Roots Grow Down?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Roots Grow Down.
Down is usually where water and grip are.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Flip a seedling and the root will try to turn.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Roots follow gravity and moisture.
The pictures today are a new seed world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do roots grow down.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
